main_body: dead weeping willow tree with hanging branches and trunk
top_band: upper arched crown of branches (rows 0-16) showing top-lit brown highlights before hanging down
evidence: Organic weeping tree has an arched crown at rows 0-16 overhanging the trunk and lower branches (rows 17-55), with clear depth layering, eave shadow under the canopy onto the trunk around rows 34-37, and a hollowed hole on the trunk at rows 42-45.

style.evidence: While the brown ramp has 5 steps and avoids flat fills, the canopy consists of repetitive vertical dark brown ropes/strips rather than cohesive volumetric clusters, and the roots at the base (rows 52-55) are flattened into a straight horizontal bar/plinth with a dark bottom line, looking much stiffer and simpler than the organic spreading roots of the Beodeul tree references.
